title: Add activation analytics on signup success
session_notes: Optional. stream = workstream slug (must equal the file slug for .engineer/plans/<slug>.json). origin = planned | adopted-mid-session (adopted requires resume_context describing work already done) | sidequest (halt-and-return detour; interrupts names the halted parent stream). resume_context + session_notes carry multi-session streams. superseded_by chains to a successor plan. verification = {result, evidence[, verified_at, notes]} is the canonical completion receipt.

Optional integration = branch-per-plan state. Single stream in a single session needs no branch (work on main and omit integration). Include it when a second stream activates or the plan is multi-session; done + branch then requires merge_commit or disposition parked/discarded.
summary: Fire a single activation-related analytics event after successful signup, with server-side auth and no PII in the event payload.
risks: Client-only tracking can be blocked or forged
PII accidentally included in event properties

complexity.need_now: Record one trustworthy signup-success event without adding a new analytics service.
complexity.simplest_viable_design: Call the existing server-side analytics adapter once after the committed signup succeeds.
evidence: The product already has a server analytics adapter
The activation funnel requires a signup-success event

rejected_options.reason: One producer and one consumer do not justify another runtime component
No second implementation or repeated change pressure exists

reversibility.rollback: Remove the one adapter call and its regression test.

tests: Manual: signup success fires event once
